scope.target: Immutable-head aggregate validation, independent governance audit, and durable closeout evidence
constraints: Long-running validation executes only in an external read-only task at a clean immutable commit.
Use exactly one completion callback or one parent event wait; do not poll.
Independent audit is read-only for the implementation subject and bound to the exact head.
Any subject repair invalidates the audit and requires a new exact-head audit.
non_goals: Repair by the validation runner or independent auditor.
Push, pull request, merge, Issue closure, Project mutation, release allocation, tag, Release, or publication.

steps: Verify the focused checks and clean immutable implementation commit.
Dispatch and accept the schema-valid long-running validation report when the gate applies.
Obtain an independent exact-head verification assessment and reconcile all P1-P3 findings.
Complete workflow evidence, validate the workflow commit range, and create the final durable local commit.
validation: External-task dispatch and completion envelope validation
execution.next_action: Begin only after GOV012-001 has a clean immutable implementation commit.
